what: On first open, photo and figure pieces scattered over a background-color curtain turn on each at its own time (.3~1.2s) with .5s ease-out. At 2.6s the group of pieces disappears together over .8s ease-in-out, then at 3.3s the curtain folds up in .6s (height 100dvh → 0, the bottom edge rises) to reveal the Hero. fx:open fires when folding starts, fx:done when fully folded

options.[data-fx-part=pieces]: Piece group (optional) — all of it disappears at once on out
options.[data-fx-part=piece]: Pieces (multiple) — turn on at data-delay (seconds), data-dur changes the length of just that piece
options.out · out-dur · out-ease: When, how long (seconds) and curve for the fragment group to disappear, default 2.6 · .8 · ease-in-out
options.shut · shut-dur · shut-ease: Time the curtain starts folding · duration (s) · Curve, default 3.3 · .6 · ease

use:
…
— Turn on hero content at shut + .5s and the header row at shut + .9s for the original order

from.where: index.html .cs-opening (five scattered photos · four people — each piece turns on at .3/.4/.5/.5/.6/.8/.8/1/1.2s, the same values as the Studio entrance effect)
